release.title: Accounting Agent Control Model
release.summary: Adds a canonical nine-element control model, complete synthetic accrual and payment scenarios, and stable mappings across every workflow.

packs.title: Bank reconciliation
packs.summary: Match bank and book activity, preserve unmatched items, and prepare a review-ready reconciliation without moving cash or posting entries.
packs.scope: One legal entity, one bank account, and one statement period using synthetic statement and ledger records.
procedures: Reproduce bank and book control totals
deterministic_checks: Adjusted bank equals adjusted book
Every match preserves both source identifiers
No transaction is consumed more than once
Unmatched items retain age, owner, evidence, and disposition
packs.expected_artifact: Reconciliation workpaper, unmatched-item register, and proposed adjustments

proposed_actions: Route two reconciling items to the cash accounting reviewer

packs.title: Accrual and journal-entry preparation
packs.summary: Establish the obligation, calculate the current-period amount, and prepare a balanced entry and reversal for independent approval.
packs.scope: One synthetic service contract and one month-end accrual calculation.
procedures: Check for an existing invoice or accrual
Route the immutable payload for approval
deterministic_checks: Debits equal credits
Entity, period, currency, accounts, and dimensions are valid
The source obligation is not recorded twice
The approved payload hash must match any later submitted payload
packs.expected_artifact: Accrual schedule, proposed entry, reversal, and unresolved-item list

proposed_actions: Submit the exact entry payload for controller approval

packs.title: Revenue contract and recognition review
packs.summary: Extract contract facts, map them to the approved revenue policy, and prepare a recognition schedule with visible judgments.
packs.accountable_owner: Revenue controller or technical accounting owner
packs.scope: One synthetic subscription contract with implementation services and a contract modification.
packs.jurisdiction: IFRS-oriented educational fixture; confirm the reporting framework and facts
deterministic_checks: Extracted terms trace to contract clauses
Allocated consideration equals transaction price
Billing, deferred revenue, and recognized revenue reconcile
Material judgments remain assigned to a reviewer
packs.expected_artifact: Structured contract facts, recognition schedule, issue memo, and proposed entries

material_judgments: Whether the amendment is a separate contract
proposed_actions: Route the recognition schedule and two judgments to the revenue controller

packs.title: ICFR control review
packs.summary: Validate a review-control population, reproduce the analysis, preserve exceptions, and prepare attributable review evidence.
packs.accountable_owner: Control owner or internal audit lead
packs.scope: One synthetic management review control, twelve monthly records, and a defined precision threshold.
packs.jurisdiction: US public-company ICFR-oriented educational fixture; confirm applicable requirements
deterministic_checks: Population count and value tie to the authoritative source
Review criteria match the approved control description
Every threshold breach has evidence and disposition
The agent does not assert operating effectiveness or certification
packs.expected_artifact: Management review packet, exception register, and attributable sign-off evidence

proposed_actions: Route the exception and complete review packet to the control owner

packs.title: Cash forecast and liquidity review
packs.summary: Tie opening cash, separate committed and forecast flows, run scenarios, and escalate liquidity risks without initiating a transfer or financing action.
packs.scope: One synthetic entity, thirteen-week forecast, base case, and defined stress scenario.
procedures: Tie opening cash to the verified position
Map flows by date, entity, and currency
Explain change and escalate limit risk
deterministic_checks: Opening cash ties to the verified cash position
Forecast formulas, currencies, and dates recalculate
Committed flows trace to approved sources
No transfer, borrowing, or investment instruction is executed
packs.expected_artifact: Thirteen-week forecast, scenario comparison, liquidity-risk register, and review briefing

proposed_actions: Escalate the projected stress-case breach to the treasurer
